Stock engine advanced to 2026-10-30 and confirms 893 advancers versus 4602 decliners; breadth supports the risk-off regime but not live company execution.
CNOOC disclosed 2027 hedging authorization up to USD2.1bn contract value and USD670m margin plus option premium; authorization is not execution and may partially damp future oil beta.
OPEC+ official result was still unavailable at cutoff; pre-meeting reporting suggests unchanged December targets, narrowing but not eliminating the catalyst distribution.
